         fontsize=19, fontfamily="serif", color=TEXT, fontweight="bold")
fig.text(0.065, 0.933,
         "A structural shift from communicable to non-communicable diseases (NCDs) across all income groups, "
         "with persistent disparities in low-income countries",
         fontsize=11, fontfamily="serif", color=SEC, fontstyle="italic")

# ============================================================
# PANEL A — Slopegraph: Top 10 DALY Causes Rank Change
# ============================================================
c90 = {d[2]: {"rank": d[1], "daly": d[3], "cat": d[4]} for d in top10_raw if d[0] == 1990}
c24 = {d[2]: {"rank": d[1], "daly": d[3], "cat": d[4]} for d in top10_raw if d[0] == 2024}

causes_90 = set(c90.keys())
causes_24 = set(c24.keys())
shared = causes_90 & causes_24
only_90 = causes_90 - causes_24
only_24 = causes_24 - causes_90

def ypos(rank):
    """Map rank to y: rank 1 at top (y=10), rank 10 at bottom (y=1)"""
    return 11 - rank

all_dalys = [d[3] for d in top10_raw]
daly_min, daly_max = min(all_dalys), max(all_dalys)

def dot_sz(daly):
    return 45 + 170 * (daly - daly_min) / (daly_max - daly_min)

# Connecting lines for shared causes
for cause in shared:
    r90, r24 = c90[cause]["rank"], c24[cause]["rank"]
    cat = c90[cause]["cat"]
    avg_daly = (c90[cause]["daly"] + c24[cause]["daly"]) / 2
    lw = 1.1 + 3.2 * (avg_daly / 200)
    ax_slope.plot([0, 1], [ypos(r90), ypos(r24)],
                  color=CAT_COLOR[cat], linewidth=lw, alpha=0.72,
                  solid_capstyle="round", zorder=2)

# Dots — 1990
for cause, info in sorted(c90.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]["rank"]):
    sz = dot_sz(info["daly"])
    ax_slope.scatter(0, ypos(info["rank"]), s=sz,
                     c=CAT_COLOR[info["cat"]], edgecolors="#fffff8",
                     linewidth=0.8, zorder=4)

# Dots — 2024
for cause, info in sorted(c24.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]["rank"]):
    sz = dot_sz(info["daly"])
    ax_slope.scatter(1, ypos(info["rank"]), s=sz,
                     c=CAT_COLOR[info["cat"]], edgecolors="#fffff8",
                     linewidth=0.8, zorder=4)

# Left labels (1990)
for cause, info in sorted(c90.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]["rank"]):
    y = ypos(info["rank"])
    ax_slope.text(-0.06, y, cause, ha="right", va="center",
                  fontsize=8.8, color=CAT_TEXT[info["cat"]], fontfamily="serif")

# Right labels (2024)
for cause, info in sorted(c24.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]["rank"]):
    y = ypos(info["rank"])
    ax_slope.text(1.06, y, cause, ha="left", va="center",
                  fontsize=8.8, color=CAT_TEXT[info["cat"]], fontfamily="serif")

# Rank shift annotations — using data coordinates
ax_slope.annotate("Dropped 5 ranks\n(#1 \u2192 #6)",
                  xy=(0.02, ypos(1)), xytext=(-0.32, ypos(0.8)),
                  fontsize=8, color="#b84042", fontfamily="serif", fontstyle="italic",
                  ha="center", va="center",
                  arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color="#cccccc", lw=0.6,
                                  connectionstyle="arc3,rad=0.35"))

ax_slope.annotate("Rose 3 ranks\n(#4 \u2192 #1)",
                  xy=(0.98, ypos(1)), xytext=(0.34, ypos(3.2)),
                  fontsize=8, color="#3c5f82", fontfamily="serif", fontstyle="italic",
                  ha="center", va="center",
                  arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color="#cccccc", lw=0.6,
                                  connectionstyle="arc3,rad=-0.3"))

# New entrants list — data coordinates, right side
new_entrants = ["Diabetes mellitus", "Low back pain", "Depressive disorders", "Lung cancer"]
ax_slope.text(1.06, ypos(9.7), "New in 2024 top 10:",
              fontsize=7.8, color=SEC, fontfamily="serif", fontstyle="italic", ha="left")
for i, c in enumerate(new_entrants):
    ax_slope.text(1.06, ypos(9.7) - (i + 1) * 0.42, f"  \u2022 {c}",
                  fontsize=7.5, color=CAT_TEXT[c24[c]["cat"]], fontfamily="serif",
                  ha="left", va="center")

# Dropped list — data coordinates, left side
dropped = ["Diarrheal diseases", "Malaria", "Tuberculosis", "Measles"]
ax_slope.text(-0.06, ypos(9.3), "Dropped from top 10:",
              fontsize=7.8, color=SEC, fontfamily="serif", fontstyle="italic", ha="right")
for i, c in enumerate(dropped):
    ax_slope.text(-0.06, ypos(9.3) - (i + 1) * 0.42, f"{c}  \u2022",
                  fontsize=7.5, color=CAT_TEXT[c90[c]["cat"]], fontfamily="serif",
                  ha="right", va="center")

# Category color key — placed inside the axes area using data coordinates
# (avoids get_xaxis_transform which breaks with invert_yaxis)
key_y = 10.75
key_x_offsets = [-0.2, 0.3, 0.8]
for i, (cat, color) in enumerate(CAT_COLOR.items()):
    kx = key_x_offsets[i]
    ax_slope.text(kx, key_y, "\u25A0", fontsize=11, color=color,
                  ha="center", va="center")
    ax_slope.text(kx + 0.06, key_y, cat, fontsize=8.8, color=CAT_TEXT[cat],
                  fontfamily="serif", va="center", fontweight="bold")

# Axis setup
ax_slope.set_xlim(-0.45, 1.55)
ax_slope.set_ylim(0.1, 10.9)
ax_slope.set_xticks([0, 1])
ax_slope.set_xticklabels(["1990", "2024"], fontsize=13, color=TEXT, fontweight="bold")
ax_slope.set_yticks(range(1, 11))
ax_slope.set_yticklabels([str(i) for i in range(1, 11)], fontsize=8.5)
ax_slope.set_ylabel("Rank  (1 = highest DALYs)", fontsize=9.5, color=SEC, labelpad=6)
ax_slope.invert_yaxis()

for spine in ax_slope.spines.values():
    spine.set_visible(False)
ax_slope.tick_params(left=False, bottom=False, labelbottom=True)

# Panel label — placed above the data area
ax_slope.text(-0.55, 11.3, "A", fontsize=14, fontfamily="serif", fontweight="bold",
              color=TEXT, clip_on=False)
ax_slope.text(0.5, 11.3, "Top 10 Global DALY Causes \u2014 Rank Change, 1990 vs 2024",
              fontsize=12, fontfamily="serif", color=TEXT, fontweight="bold",
              ha="center", clip_on=False)

# Data note
ax_slope.text(0.5, -0.9, "Dot size proportional to DALY burden",
              fontsize=8, fontfamily="serif", color=TER, fontstyle="italic",
              ha="center", clip_on=False)

# ============================================================
# PANEL B — Global DALY category totals: dumbbell chart
# ============================================================
gb = {}
for yr, cat, daly in global_raw:
    gb[(yr, cat)] = daly

categories_ordered = ["Communicable", "NCD", "Injury"]
y_vals = [2, 1, 0]

# Subtle background band for reference
for i in range(3):
    ax_global.axhline(y=i, color="#eeeeee", linewidth=0.3, zorder=0)

for i, cat in enumerate(categories_ordered):
    v90 = gb[(1990, cat)]
    v24 = gb[(2024, cat)]
    color = CAT_COLOR[cat]
    y = y_vals[i]

    ax_global.plot([v90, v24], [y, y], color=color, linewidth=2.5, alpha=0.55,

    # Category label on left
    ax_global.text(-80, y, cat, ha="right", va="center",

                   fontweight="bold")

    # Value labels
    ax_global.text(v90 - 45, y + 0.25, f"{v90:.0f}M", ha="center", va="bottom",

    ax_global.text(v24 + 45, y + 0.25, f"{v24:.0f}M", ha="center", va="bottom",

    # Percent change
    pct = (v24 - v90) / v90 * 100
    arrow = "\u2191" if pct > 0 else "\u2193"
    ax_global.text((v90 + v24) / 2, y - 0.32,

ax_global.text(gb[(2024, "NCD")], 2.55, "2024", ha="center", va="bottom",

causes_90 = set(c90.keys())
causes_24 = set(c24.keys())
shared = causes_90 & causes_24
only_90 = causes_90 - causes_24
only_24 = causes_24 - causes_90

def ypos(rank):
    """Map rank to y: rank 1 at top (y=10), rank 10 at bottom (y=1)"""
    return 11 - rank

all_dalys = [d[3] for d in top10_raw]
daly_min, daly_max = min(all_dalys), max(all_dalys)

def dot_sz(daly):
    return 45 + 170 * (daly - daly_min) / (daly_max - daly_min)

                  color=CAT_COLOR[cat], linewidth=lw, alpha=0.72,

for cause, info in sorted(c90.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]["rank"]):

                     linewidth=0.8, zorder=4)

# Dots — 2024
for cause, info in sorted(c24.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]["rank"]):
    sz = dot_sz(info["daly"])
    ax_slope.scatter(1, ypos(info["rank"]), s=sz,
                     c=CAT_COLOR[info["cat"]], edgecolors="#fffff8",
                     linewidth=0.8, zorder=4)

# Left labels (1990) — mark dropped causes with dagger
for cause, info in sorted(c90.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]["rank"]):
    y = ypos(info["rank"])
    if cause in only_90:
        label = f"{cause} \u2021"
        fs = 8.8
    else:
        label = cause
        fs = 8.8
    ax_slope.text(-0.06, y, label, ha="right", va="center",
                  fontsize=fs, color=CAT_TEXT[info["cat"]], fontfamily="serif")

# Right labels (2024) — mark new causes with dagger
for cause, info in sorted(c24.items(), key=lambda x: x[1]["rank"]):
    y = ypos(info["rank"])
    if cause in only_24:
        label = f"\u2020 {cause}"
        fs = 8.8
    else:
        label = cause
        fs = 8.8
    ax_slope.text(1.06, y, label, ha="left", va="center",
                  fontsize=fs, color=CAT_TEXT[info["cat"]], fontfamily="serif")

# Rank shift annotations
ann_color = "#888888"
ax_slope.annotate("Dropped 5 ranks\n(#1 \u2192 #6)",

ax_slope.annotate("Rose 3 ranks\n(#4 \u2192 #1)",

                                  connectionstyle="arc3,rad=-0.3"))

# Co-located small annotation for new entrants in 2024
ax_slope.text(0.5, ypos(10.1), "  \u2020 New in 2024  |  \u2021 Dropped after 1990",

for pct in [25, 50, 75]:

ax_income.set_yticks([0, 25, 50, 75, 100])

# Category key — placed in top-right of panel
key_x = 8.25
for j, (cat, color) in enumerate(CAT_COLOR.items()):
    ky = 96 - j * 6.5
    ax_income.text(key_x, ky, "\u25A0", fontsize=10, color=color,
                   ha="left", va="center")
    ax_income.text(key_x + 0.3, ky, cat, fontsize=8.8, color=CAT_TEXT[cat],
                   fontfamily="serif", va="center", fontweight="bold")

# Panel label and subtitle
ax_income.text(-1.5, 109, "C", fontsize=14, fontfamily="serif",
               fontweight="bold", color=TEXT, clip_on=False)
ax_income.text(3.75, 109, "Disease Burden Composition by World Bank Income Group",
               fontsize=12, fontfamily="serif", color=TEXT,
               fontweight="bold", ha="center", clip_on=False)

# ============================================================
# Footnote
# ============================================================
fig.text(0.065, 0.012,
         "Source: GBD-style modeled estimates; 2024 are projected. "
         "Communicable category includes maternal, neonatal, and nutritional conditions per GBD convention. "
         "DALY = disability-adjusted life years. NCD = non-communicable disease.",
         fontsize=7.8, fontfamily="serif", color=TER, fontstyle="italic")

# ============================================================
# Save
# ============================================================
fig.savefig("/app/output/result.png", dpi=200, facecolor="#fffff8", edgecolor="none")
plt.close(fig)
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")

# ============================================================
